spec.kitLine: Recovers 1% final Max HP every 1 sec cont.
spec.durationSemantics: continuous — battle-long HoT, 1 tick/sec from t=0; NOT a finite durationSec window
spec.triggerIdentity: passive ('Activates at the start of battle, only if self is alive') — no shot/hit/burst gate
spec.targetSet: self + 2 adjacent allies (selfAndAdjacent; 'on both sides' = immediate neighbors, total 3 units) — NOT all allies
spec.nearestWrongModel: target widened to {kind:'allies'} (every ally healed), or ticks modeled as a short finite heal that stops emitting recovery events
spec.distinguishingAssertion: a recovery-trigger consumer (crown in controlComp) slotted ADJACENT to flora shows her recovery-gated buffApply refreshing continuously from early in the fight; the same consumer slotted 2+ positions away from flora shows ZERO recovery-gated buffApply events. Green under selfAndAdjacent, red under target:allies (non-adjacent consumer would also fire)
spec.inertness: must NOT emit any damage-relevant stat buff; must NOT heal non-adjacent allies; must not require flora to fire/burst (alive-at-start is the only gate)

spec.scope: healing-received modifier — no StatKey exists for incoming-healing

spec.nearestWrongModel: encoded as maxHpPct / defPct / some proxy buff to 'keep the line', or silently dropped without an unmodeled entry
spec.distinguishingAssertion: no buffApply event with any damage-relevant stat keyed to this line; the verbatim text appears in override.unmodeled.skill1
spec.inertness: must NOT move any damage total; must NOT be proxied by an unrelated stat

spec.scope: modifies stack count of existing buffs on targets — the schema has NO effect kind that increments another buff's stacks

spec.targetSet: all Electric Code allies (alliesOfElement Electric) — element-scoped, NOT self+adjacent, NOT all allies
spec.nearestWrongModel: target read off the FIRST header (self+adjacent) instead of this line's own 'all Electric Code allies'; or trigger mis-keyed to interval:100s; or effect faked as a generic stat buff
spec.distinguishingAssertion: structural only: the override either (a) carries a documented GAP note + verbatim unmodeled entry, or (b) any block claiming this line must fire its first activation no earlier than 100 flora rounds (check flora's shot-event count at first activation) and must touch ONLY Electric-ally targets
spec.inertness: must NOT buff non-Electric allies; must NOT fire before 100 flora hits; must not be silently dropped

spec.scope: defensive shield; no HP pool / no incoming damage in v1

spec.nearestWrongModel: passive shield at t=0 or interval shield 'to represent uptime' — this would fire 'shielded' triggers on shield-synergy teammates and over-credit
spec.distinguishingAssertion: ZERO shield-driven downstream activations all fight: no buffApply from any 'shielded'-trigger block on any ally; the verbatim line sits in override.unmodeled.skill2 with a note that the trigger is environmentally inert
spec.inertness: must NOT emit a shield event at battle start or on any timer; must NOT feed requiresShielded/shielded consumers

spec.scope: generic trueDamagePct (Damage Up bucket), all damage — not normal-attack-scoped
spec.durationSemantics: 5 sec per activation, refreshable (S1's continuous HoT re-tops adjacent allies in real play)
spec.triggerIdentity: 'HP of one adjacent ally reaches Max HP' — no TriggerDef exists for this; engine cannot express it. Honest options: (a) unmodeled + ⚑ (large team-damage loss, must be declared), or (b) ⚑ CALIBRATED approximation as near-permanent passive justified by the S1 continuous HoT — NEVER an unflagged silent passive
spec.targetSet: all allies — includes self; NOT electric-only, NOT adjacent-only (the gate is positional, the buff is team-wide)
spec.nearestWrongModel: (1) silently dropped as 'heal-adjacent, inert' losing the biggest sustained team buff; (2) target narrowed to self+adjacent by conflating the trigger gate with the buff target; (3) unflagged permanent passive presented as measured
spec.distinguishingAssertion: if modeled: buffApply stat 'trueDamagePct' value 30.97 lands on EVERY ally (targetSlug set covers all 5 incl. flora), value exactly 30.97, and the override carries a ⚑ uptime justification in note; if unmodeled: verbatim line in unmodeled.skill2 AND notes must price the omission. Red under the narrowed-target misread: a non-adjacent ally shows the buffApply
spec.inertness: must NOT appear as a self-only buff; must NOT be folded into the burst's 42.39% as one merged line (different magnitudes/durations/triggers)

spec.scope: heal (no damage bucket) — tandem-relevant: drives 'recovery' triggers on teammates
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast stage:2 (flora is Burst II) — fires ONLY on rotations flora herself casts, never on another B2's cast
spec.nearestWrongModel: skipped as 'heals are inert in a no-HP sim' (taxonomy trap #4 — crown's recovery-gated buffs in the fixture make this damage-relevant), or keyed to fullBurstEnter so it also fires on crown-led full bursts
spec.distinguishingAssertion: crown's recovery-gated buffApply count steps exactly when flora's burstCast events occur; on a full-burst rotation where crown (not flora) cast stage 2, NO new recovery-driven buffApply originates from flora
spec.inertness: must NOT fire on non-flora rotations; must NOT itself grant any damage stat

spec.scope: generic trueDamagePct (Damage Up bucket), all damage of every ally

spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter trigger (over-credits crown-led rotations), or permanent/30s duration, or value merged with the S2 30.97% line

Green under burstCast, red under fullBurstEnter
spec.inertness: must NOT be active at t=0 before flora's first cast; must NOT refresh on other units' bursts; flora's own normal-attack damage outside the window unchanged

skill1: Incoming healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks up to 5 time(s).
■ Activates after landing 100 normal attack(s). Affects all Electric Code allies. Stack count of buffs ▲ 1. (if no stack-increment primitive is shipped — GAP, must be recorded not dropped)
skill2: ■ Activates when the HP of one of the allies on both sides is lower than 90%. Affects all allies. Generates a Shield with 10.22% of the skill user's final Max HP for 10 sec. (trigger environmentally inert in a damage-free sim — must fire zero times)

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, ranked: (1) burst True Damage keyed to fullBurstEnter instead of burstCast stage 2 — the controlComp fixture fields crown (20s B2) alongside flora (40s B2), so full bursts genuinely occur on rotations flora did not cast; this is THE discriminating test of the review. (2) S2 True Damage ▲30.97%: its trigger ('adjacent ally reaches Max HP') has no TriggerDef — the driver must EITHER ship a ⚑-flagged near-permanent approximation (justified by S1's continuous HoT keeping adjacent allies topped, uptime estimate + recipe in note) OR record it unmodeled with the damage cost priced; a silent passive with no ⚑, or a silent drop, both fail. (3) Target-set conflation across headers: S1a is self+2-adjacent, S1b is all-Electric, S2/burst are all-allies — each line's 'Affects' clause is independent; carrying the first header's target into later lines is wrong. (4) Skipping the two heal lines as 'inert in a no-HP sim' — crown's recovery trigger makes both tandem-load-bearing (taxonomy trap #4). (5) reloadFrames 171 is a known-unreliable datamine field → ⚑; ammo 300 / hitsPerShot 1 mean the S1b 100-hit trigger equals 100 pulls, so no hits-vs-rounds divergence to exploit there, but the first-activation-time check still distinguishes hitCount from an interval:100 misread. (6) The shield line's faithful sim behavior is total inertness — any shield event anywhere in the log is a red flag.
